description: List the organization outbound webhook endpoints, with health: enabled, failing_since (start of the current run of failed deliveries, null while healthy), and disabled_reason ("consecutive_failures" when the platform switched it off after 3 days without a successful delivery). Read-only: endpoints and signing secrets are managed in the dashboard.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page next_cursor. Page until next_cursor is null; never parse a cursor.

name: list_webhook_endpoints
